forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Prices currently exceed $1,670/mt. Escalating Black Sea maritime hazards and poor regional harvests support prices holding above $1,600.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: A collapse below $1,600 within two months would be an oversized move given current stability. The market underestimates price persistence near term.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
